name: Mukhyamantri Sampoorna Pushti Yojana: Purna Aahaara for Children (6 months - 5 years)
benefit: Under the scheme, eligible beneficiaries are provided Take Home Ration (THR) of 3 kg per month, along with 30 eggs per month, for a duration of 112 days from the date of enrollment. **Note:** Parents and caregivers are requested to have their children's growth monitored at Anganwadi Centre (AWCs) and take special care of them.
_eligibility_text: 1. The beneficiary must be a resident of Odisha. 1. The beneficiary must be a child aged between 6 months and 5 years. 1. The child must be identified as Severely Acute Malnourished (SAM) by an Anganwadi Worker or ICDS functionary.
